mapper.sql: v.id, v.author_id, u.nickname AS author_name, v.category_id, vc.name AS category_name, v.title, v.description, v.file_path, v.status, v.published_at, v.deleted_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_likes l WHERE l.video_id = v.id) AS current_like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video_favorites f WHERE f.video_id = v.id) AS current_favorite_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM play_records p WHERE p.video_id = v.id) AS play_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) FROM play_records p WHERE p.video_id = v.id) AS unique_viewer_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM share_records sh WHERE sh.video_id = v.id) AS share_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.video_id = v.id AND c.is_deleted = FALSE) AS valid_comment_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM videos v JOIN users u ON u.id = v.author_id JOIN video_categories vc ON vc.id = v.category_id WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED'
